dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned ratings, text and helpful votes feed the three Problem 2(a) measures.
LDA topics and cleaned text feed attribute dictionaries.
Weighted rating evidence and review fields feed reputation contributions.
Preference vectors feed product-specific design advice.
Reputation and review features feed the nested LSTM forecast.
Monthly review series feed ripple and lag testing.
Sentiment scores feed five-rank rating-text alignment.
Lag findings enter the letter only as bounded monitoring evidence.
Deviation analysis informs rating guidance and review interpretation.
